entries.zh: 相谦：互相谦让、彼此客气
entries.en: to yield to each other; mutually courteous, deferential

entries.zh: 互：互相、彼此（西解作“双方交互、非谓相合”）
entries.en: mutually; each other (17c gloss: 'both, not in accord/concert')

entries.zh: 哄：吓唬、喧吓使惧；兼有哄骗义
entries.en: to frighten, to overawe with noise; fear, dread (17c also: to fool)
entries.notes: M 栏混入残迹（dargonay voce= 不可解）；“哄”17 世纪兼有吓唬、哄骗二义，取西解 amedrentar（吓唬）为主。

entries.en: to deceive by frightening or coaxing; to trick, cheat

entries.zh: 慌张：惊慌失措、心慌意乱
entries.en: flustered, alarmed; in a panic, rattled
to threaten, menace; to act insolently and willfully (刁, blustering intimidation)
entries.notes: “雕”系“刁”之借字，闽南语“放刁”即耍蛮相胁；据下条 放雕 与西语 amenaçar 互证。

entries.zh: 放刁：耍蛮吓唬人、泼皮要挟
entries.en: to threaten, act the bully; insolent intimidation
entries.notes: 同上，“雕”通“刁”（放刁＝耍蛮吓人），据西语 amenaçar 与第 7 条互证。

entries.zh: 讦：揭发、攻讦他人隐私（借以要挟）
entries.en: to expose another's secrets or faults (so as to threaten him with them); to attack, denounce
entries.notes: 西语释义残讹（abelin quido 不可解），据大意“以对方之事相要挟”与 訐（攻讦、揭人隐私）义相合定释义。

entries.zh: 茂盛：草木繁茂（如原野草场）
和：和睦、和好；友谊（亦作连词“和/与”）
entries.en: harmony, amity; friendship; also conjunction 'and, with'
harmonious, in concord; on good terms
entries.notes: 汉栏第二字原件存疑（睦/陸），据西语 concordia 与 M/R 音读定为“和睦”。

entries.zh: 和合：和睦契合、合好相处
entries.en: in harmony and concord; amicably united

entries.zh: 和气：和善随和（肯顺对方心意）
和谐：融洽相合（如夫妻和睦）
entries.en: harmonious, in accord; marital concord (as a wedded couple)

entries.zh: 和顺：温和柔顺、不相违逆
entries.en: gentle and compliant; harmonious without contradicting one another

entries.zh: 和同：同心相合、随和不异
entries.en: in accord, of harmonized wills (concord like music)
